plan.title: Scholarship Applicants Overview
plan.subtitle: Key metrics and trends in scholarship applications by status, demographics, and performance

panels.title: Approved Rate
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN "Status" = 'Approved' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants"

panels.title: Avg Marks %
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG("Marks %"), 1) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Marks %" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Avg Family Income
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG("Family Income")) AS n FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Family Income" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Applications by Status
panels.sql: SELECT "Status", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applications by Category
panels.sql: SELECT "Category", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Applications by District
panels.sql: SELECT "District", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Marks Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT FLOOR("Marks %" / 10) * 10 AS bin, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" WHERE "Marks %" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Talukas by Applications
panels.sql: SELECT "Taluka", COUNT(*) AS count FROM "scholarship_applicants" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
